messages:
Omar (Partnerships): hey y'all — Bluehaven sent over the marketplace tile + co-branded one-pager for the joint announcement. Need quick brand & legal sanity check before we reply. Links: /drive/Bluehaven/bluehaven-redwood-onepager-v1.pdf and marketplace-preview.png. They want our primary logo on the marketplace thumbnail and the full mark on the PDF header. timeline: aiming to publish next Tue so prefer approvals by EOD Mon.

Marco (Design): opening the PDF now. first impressions: header lockup looks fine at full size but the thumbnail crops our mark badly. two things:
- marketplace thumbnail needs a center-safe area; can't have logotype cut.
- suggested swap: use `redwood-monogram-white.svg` for the 144x144 tile + keep full lockup on PDF. Also the blue gradient they picked introduces banding at 72dpi — request a flattened 72dpi export for the marketplace, and a 300dpi PDF export for the one-pager.

Alyssa (Product): thanks Marco. quick check on the case blurb — Bluehaven pulled this line from our convo: "We cut inference costs 3x and doubled throughput". They want to shorten to "Redwood cut costs and improved throughput." I'd rather keep the 3x number if it's accurate. Anyone confirm metrics are safe to publish?

Kate (Legal): two items: 1) numeric claims — we need a short data attestation from the customer success or the account team confirming the "3x" figure and timeframe; otherwise prefer qualitative phrasing. 2) quote edits: if they alter phrasing we require sign-off from Alyssa (or the quoted person). I'll prepare a one-paragraph quote license to include in the one-pager footer and a branded usage clause for the marketplace listing (where, duration, credit line).

DesignOps Bot: alt text suggestion for PDF header: `Redwood and Bluehaven logos side-by-side on a dark gradient header, co-branded solution for low-latency inference` :white_check_mark:

Marco (Design): practical request list to send to Bluehaven (I suggest a single email):
1) provide `redwood-monogram-white.svg` for thumbnail usage OR a 144x144 PNG with safe padding
2) provide a 300dpi PDF export and a separate 72dpi flattened PNG for marketplace
3) update thumbnail crop so our mark isn't within 10% edge margin (we can provide a crop guide)
4) move the exec quote below the header on the PDF so header remains clean
5) ensure color profile is sRGB for web assets

Omar (Partnerships): will draft a consolidated reply. @Kate can you paste the quote license text here so I can include it? Also @Alyssa can you confirm whether the "3x" line is approved or whether you'd prefer the safer qualitative line?

Kate (Legal): here's a draft paragraph you can paste into the reply (we'll attach a formal file if Bluehaven signs): "By license granted herein, Bluehaven Cloud is authorized to reproduce and display the attached quote from Redwood Inference, attributed to Alyssa [last name], Product Lead, solely in connection with the co-branded one-pager and the Bluehaven marketplace listing. This authorization is non-exclusive, revocable, and limited to the assets and duration specified in writing. Redwood reserves the right to withdraw or require removal of the quote if the context materially changes or if the quote is used in a manner inconsistent with Redwood's brand guidelines."

Alyssa (Product): okay — I can vouch for the 3x if account team confirms it's measured over the 30-day pilot. @Omar please check with Raj (AM). If account confirms, I'm fine with the exact number. If not, change to "significantly reduced costs and increased throughput."

Omar (Partnerships): noted. I'll ping Raj and loop back. Also thinking about social tiles — do we want a separate co-branded social image (with logos + short quote) or just drive to the one-pager? Marketing preference? @MKT Bot any guidance on tweet-sized asset?

MKT Bot: Ticket PARTNER-2099 opened: "Bluehaven co-brand asset approvals" assigned to Omar, Marco, Kate. Suggested deliverables: 300dpi one-pager PDF, 144x144 marketplace tile, 1200x628 social tile. Due: 2025-08-05.

Marco (Design): if we approve social, ask Bluehaven for a version without small legal text so we can overlay captions. Also request source PSD/FIG file if they want us to produce final social images.

Kate (Legal): also add trademark notice requirement and a link to our public brand guidelines in the footer: https://redwood.example/brand-guidelines. We'll need Bluehaven to include our trademark attribution line exactly as provided.

Omar (Partnerships): great — I'll send a single consolidated email with Marco's asset list + Kate's license paragraph + MKT Bot ticket link. Will update thread after Raj confirms metrics. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
